name: Zebah
title: Midianite King Defeated by Gideon
summary: Zebah was one of two Midianite kings who were defeated and killed by Gideon. Along with Zalmunna, he led Midianite forces that plundered and oppressed Israel. Gideon pursued them across the Jordan and executed them for killing his brothers at Tabor.

keyEvents.title: Midianite Oppression of Israel
keyEvents.description: Zebah and Zalmunna were kings over the Midianites who for seven years plundered and oppressed the people of Israel, causing them to cry out to the Lord for help.

keyEvents.title: Gideon's Victory Over the Midianites
keyEvents.description: Gideon and his 300 men defeated the large Midianite army with torches, jars, and horns, and the Midianites fled in panic.

keyEvents.title: The Pursuit Across the Jordan
keyEvents.description: Gideon pursued Zebah and Zalmunna across the Jordan with his exhausted 300 men, even though they were tired and hungry.

keyEvents.title: The Capture of Zebah and Zalmunna
keyEvents.description: Gideon surprised the Midianite camp at Karkor and captured the two kings, Zebah and Zalmunna, while their entire army was scattered.

keyEvents.title: The Interrogation of the Brothers at Tabor
keyEvents.description: Gideon asked Zebah and Zalmunna about the men they had killed at Tabor. They admitted that these men resembled Gideon's brothers and looked like sons of kings.

keyEvents.title: The Execution of Zebah and Zalmunna
keyEvents.description: Gideon ordered his firstborn son Jether to kill them, but the boy was afraid. Then Gideon himself killed Zebah and Zalmunna and took the crescent ornaments from the camels' necks.
